recent.text: So much of the culture starts with Alex Ovechkin. Tom Wilson told me something he’s done that’s made the culture really great is he’s so welcoming and everyone can just come in and be themselves. That goes a long way in the room. Those guys truly are a tight-knit bunch
recent.author: Sammi Silber 🏒
recent.quoted_text: @sammisilber The organization, from the front office to the locker room, generally seems to have good vibes. People seem to genuinely care about each other and enjoy each other. Seeing drama in other organizations (particularly that NJ statement) makes me wonder what the caps do to keep it?

recent.text: I actually think Alex Ovechkin has looked really good of late and is getting in the swing of things. Still playing an important role as captain and enjoying the ride. The chances are there and he’s getting closer and closer. Once one drops, I think more will follow.
recent.author: Sammi Silber 🏒
recent.quoted_text: @sammisilber What do you think about OV's low number of goals? In a slump? Nagging injury? Just trying to enjoy his last season? Your thoughts?

recent.text: Alex Ovechkin and Jose Theodore, I grew up in the DMV so those were the names that introduced me to the Caps and hockey and made me fall in love with the sport But also both Nick Backstroms, Rick Nash, Anze Kopitar Josh Harding and Cal Clutterbuck
recent.author: Sammi Silber 🏒
recent.quoted_text: @sammisilber This may be something I could guess, but who was the hockey player that made you want to play hockey/write about hockey? Are they the same player? Different?
